name: aruco-server-sample
description: Detect markers from an ffmpeg rawvideo stream

config.camera_notes_windows: default 'Integrated Webcam'. List devices: ffmpeg -f dshow -list_devices true -i dummy
config.camera_notes_osx: default 'default'. List devices: ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""

scripts.stream_unix: ffmpeg -f v4l2 -video_size ${npm_package_config_cameraWidth}x${npm_package_config_cameraHeight} -i /dev/${npm_package_config_camera} -f rawvideo -r 15 -pix_fmt rgba -method POST -headers "Authorization: Bearer ${ARUCO_TOKEN}" http://127.0.0.1:${npm_package_config_port}/stream
scripts.stream_osx: ffmpeg -f avfoundation -video_size ${npm_package_config_cameraWidth}x${npm_package_config_cameraHeight} -i "default" -f rawvideo -r 15 -pix_fmt rgba -method POST -headers "Authorization: Bearer ${ARUCO_TOKEN}" http://127.0.0.1:${npm_package_config_port}/stream
scripts.stream_win: ffmpeg -f dshow -video_size %npm_package_config_cameraWidth%x%npm_package_config_cameraHeight% -i video="Integrated Webcam" -f rawvideo -r 15 -pix_fmt rgba -method POST -headers "Authorization: Bearer %ARUCO_TOKEN%" http://127.0.0.1:%npm_package_config_port%/stream
